title: Tile coding, semi-gradient TD, and SARSA on Mountain Car
brief: Build tile-coding features, measure the value error of a linear estimate, and write the semi-gradient TD update. Then put the action into 2-D tile features and train a Mountain Car controller with episodic semi-gradient SARSA.
hints: In tiling k the tile index is floor((x - low) / width + k / n_tilings), and tiling k's entries start at k * (n_tiles + 1). Clip x to [low, high] before anything else.
The semi-gradient update is w + alpha * delta * x, where delta = r + gamma * (w @ x2) - w @ x and the bootstrap term is dropped when terminated is true. The target is a constant: it gets no gradient.
value_error is d @ (Phi @ w - v) ** 2, a single dot product.

state_action_features puts tile_features_2d(pos, vel, N_TILES, N_TILINGS) into the block action * PER_ACTION up to (action + 1) * PER_ACTION. Every other entry is 0, so only the taken action's weights change.
The SARSA target is r + gamma * (w @ x2) * (not terminated), where x2 holds the features of (s2, a2), the action the agent will take next. Using a instead of a2 gives a different method.
In semi_gradient_sarsa, w.reshape(N_ACTIONS, -1) @ x gives all three action values at once. Take the next action before the update, and carry it into the next step.
